hooks.command: jq -c 'if .duration_ms == null then empty else (.duration_ms as $d | "Command took " + (if $d < 1000 then "\($d) ms" elif $d < 60000 then "\($d / 100 | round / 10) s" else "\($d / 60000 | floor) min \($d % 60000 / 1000 | floor) s" end)) as $t | {systemMessage: $t, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: .hook_event_name, additionalContext: ($t + ". The user asked to see this: state the time in your next message to them.")}} end' 2>/dev/null || true
